question: What conduct must be abandoned once practice yields an even mind?
premises: Steady practice produces an even mind
Conventional village duties bind the practitioner
Abandonment of such duties is prescribed
inference: Through practice, one with an even mind should abandon conventional village duties
uncertainties: grāma-dharma may refer broadly to worldly or social obligations
plain_english: Through practice, with an even mind, one should abandon the duties of village life.
